build_kenlm_perplexity: build a Kenlm language model to compute perplexity of text documents using SentencePiece tokenization
create_sentencepiece_tokenizer: create a SentencePiece tokenizer that loads a model from HuggingFace Hub and tokenizes text into space-separated pieces
test_get_perplexity: test the KenlmModel.get_perplexity method to compute perplexity of a given document string
refactor_normalize_text: refactor the KenlmModel.normalize method to preprocess text with lowercase, number normalization, and unicode punctuation replacement
review_from_pretrained: review the KenlmModel.from_pretrained class method to instantiate a Kenlm model from a dataset and language
